استقصصن (form X)

# اُسْتُقْصِصْنَ (ustuqṣiṣna) /us.tuq.sˤisˤ.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَقَصَّ (istaqaṣṣa)
# اِسْتَقْصِصْنَ (istaqṣiṣna) /is.taq.sˤisˤ.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَقَصَّ (istaqaṣṣa)
